notes.title: Update on Co OPERATION: MultiTurn - the demo is nearly ready! 🎉
notes.notes:
We are now *very nearly* at the point where we can release the first version of this new game I’ve been working on with my new company Mind Feast Games..! ⏳

What’s the story behind the game? Well, running hospitals is expensive. A clever bean in central government decided that tearing up requirements for medical qualifications would help. So… volunteers are now welcome in hospitals! 🤷 You decide to enrol and help your local hospital. You can be one of four characters whose specialist skills are throwing and catching; Jason the American footballer 🏈, Prisha the pizza chef 👩‍🍳, Ethan the juggler 🤹 or Tamira the javelin athlete 🏃‍♀️

Josh and Kaitlin, our two artists, have been working hard on these 2D characters and the 3D objects that you’ll have to navigate in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32976931/5c005fd535d6be2ed6f6cf3736b070a198e3d7d2.jpg[/img]
This is Prisha the chef 👩‍🍳 getting a patient to a bed in the fastest way possible!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32976931/6a5ddb6f42ceab172b0415d1793c548a701cb0d3.gif[/img]
And a water cooler that is looking a bit the worse for wear . . . is that a fish inside it?! 😳

Josh even managed to teach himself animation so the characters can do this now:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32976931/ce3550a8336535c5600a3b23252df125bde4d985.gif[/img]
Ethan the juggler idling, running and throwing 🤹

I’ve been weaving together the 2D characters, 3D objects and hospital world to create some fun levels - here’s how level one in two-player mode is shaping up:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32976931/313d487d5f16ae98f6110255de870c6397361ae5.png[/img]
Tamira the athlete and Jason the American footballer waiting to be given their actions! 💪


Joe and Rupert have been doing stirling work on the code, and the characters are now able to do 4 moves in a row without breaking the game engine 🎉 Joe has also revealed a hidden talent for UI (user interface) design and has created lovely selection screens for levels and characters:

[previewyoutube=ZsovWtBRq7s;full][/previewyoutube]


Our [url=https://discord.gg/WAYDn3TA]Discord[/url] has been steadily growing and we have been playing games such as Build-a-body, Emoji Movies and Story Hive 🐝.

Here’s a collage of each mini-chapter we made for “Book 1” of Story Hive. One of our community members created it so we could remember the laughs we had writing it - thanks James!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32976931/8b641c67612d4e7d15870c02386d85a038d78d6f.png[/img]
We also play live games like JackBox once a week which Bronte has been streaming on our Discord so we can all play together.


✨The even more exciting news is that the demo is very nearly ready!! ✨
You can [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2097840/Co_OPERATION_MultiTurn/]wishlist it on Steam[/url] now!


Of course, you can also get in touch with any questions, queries or comments - we’d love to hear from you!

See you soon,
Shaz, Julia and the MFG team



New Game Announcement! Co OPERATION: MultiTurn is coming..!
A few of you might already know…I have been working on a new game called Co OPERATION: MultiTurn with my new company Mind Feast Games..!

And we have exciting news! The Steam page is now public 🥳

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TEnCM1ckTHc 

We’re making this game to help people feel connected socially and emotionally. Here’s how you can get involved with the early demo or the more polished version which will come later:

Wishlist the game on Steam! That way you’ll be the first to know when it's available to purchase and play with your friends and family.

Want to get involved before the demo is out? Join our Discord community! You can chat with the team and the other community members and play games together (we have a weekly live games session as well as longer, asynchronous games that run over several days).

The experience is all about teamwork, communication and fun. We want our development process to reflect that so we’re being very open. The Discord is also where we’ll be sharing our progress and concepts so you can see the game as it develops. We get the community involved in creative decisions for the game and company too - lots to get stuck into!

Want to be one of the first people to play the demo once it's ready? Join our mailing list!

Have any questions? Start a discussion with us on Steam!

If you care about co-op games and like the idea of an inviting and accessible game that you can play with friends, family and partners while still having a gaming experience that feels like it has some depth… get involved 😊 Join us on Discord and/or the Steam forum and be part of turning this thing from a good idea into a great game.



Cheers,
Shaz and the Mind Feast Games team

notes.title: Update 6
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32976931/f75f9ab9b08822d1738a287804b00e7390ee55b0.gif[/img]

How's everyone doing during the (hopefully!) last weeks of the social lock-downs that many countries are experiencing? As a game designer/developer working from home is quite normal for me. Although I will be glad when everyone is more free and we can have friends over again/visit people.

We thought it was about time we updated BFF or Die. I keep an eye on any comments people leave about the game across various communication channels so decided to make the adjustments below.

[h1] Controller Options [/h1]
Alex made a really cool new intro animation more clearly shows you can have: 
[list]
[*] Shared controllers (two people on each pad)
[*] Separate controllers (one person on each pad)
[*] One person on keyboard
[*] Two people on keyboard
[*] Any combination of the above
[/list]

I think the flexibility of the controls is really cool. I was quite proud of the team for coming up with how it works after [i]a lot[/i] of different ideas and testing. However some people didn't realise all those options have always been possible [i]and [/i] without having to faff about with any option menus (which i am not a fan of). Let's see if the new intro animation clears that up..!

[h1] Difficulty [/h1]
It's really hard trying to make a difficulty curve that suits everyone. When I used to go round to gaming events and watch people play there would always be a big difference between the skill level of players. We could have gone the old way of doing "easy mode, normal mode, hard mode" but I think that's not optimal because how can you know what mode you should play if you've never played it before? What we have instead is a dynamic difficulty that responds to how you do in the game. Ideally we want everyone to have the experience that is right for them, whether they are an experienced gamer or someone who just started playing PC games recently.

So, this update increases that range. Whether you are super skilled or just learning how it all works, the difficulty should adapt to you and be fun for you. By default, the game is a bit more exciting/harder in the earlier levels now because I think most people on Steam are in the "experienced gamer" category.

For the challenge seekers, the "infinite mode" (random levels, keep going until you die once) which unlocks after you complete the story game is pretty damn hard. Even I can't get more than 8 or so levels into it before I die and have to restart. Especially now that I've forgotten all those different level configurations I designed! (I do play it 2-player mode by myself though, two characters on one control pad, for extra challenge).

[h1] Environments [/h1]
Just a small change - we swapped some of the environment art around for a bit more visual variety.

That's it for now.

See you later
Shaz
(The game designer)

notes.title: Update 4: Camera Viewpoint
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32976931/2a7473c024bd54d004ee57dc8e054fa7d09de86a.png[/img]

It's midnight here in the UK, so obvioulsy it's... the perfect time to upload a new build to Steam!

[h1]Main View[/h1]
The main gameplay viewpoint has been adjusted. People playing on a small screen or while sitting far back from a TV should find everything easier to see now, especially on the busier/harder levels.

Someone had emailed us to let us know that they found it hard to see what was going on at the top of the screen on their setup and we we glad to receive that feedback so we could adjust things and (hopefully) fix the issue they and others may have had. So thanks to that Steam gamer who emailed us!

[h1]More Infinity, More Music[/h1]
If you missed the news, the previous update added more infinity and more music. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791462498339/announcements/detail/1690437771459360685]You can read the details here[/url].

[h1]Online Co-op with Parsec[/h1]
For those who really want to play BFF or Die as an online co-op game, well now you can using Parsec! [url=https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791462498339/announcements/detail/1682551398073335474]You can read about Parsec in our other post[/url].

Cheers,
Alex, Shaz, Anj

notes.title: Update Three: More Infinity, More Music
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32976931/48a5ed07956f42bd3c62f79cd16f094d02eefb09.png[/img]

Merry December,

The latest update just went live on Steam!

[h1]More Infinity[/h1]
After you complete story mode, the “Infinite Trials” will unlock. This is a rogue-like-ish mode that really tests out your co-op skills. Every level is randomised with a mix of procedural and preset content. You only get one chance each time you try - If you die you go back to the home scene. See how many trials you can complete in a row without dying..! Spoiler: it’s *hard*. In this update we added a lot of new configurations to infinite mode so it should keep you challenged for quite a while...

[h1]Music[/h1]
We’ve doubled the length of the main gameplay music and added more variety to the atmosphere. Hope you enjoy it :)

[h1]Sounds[/h1]
We’ve added a range of new sound effects to make the Time-Tech even more enjoyable to use and the game-world that little bit more alive.

[h1]Bug Fix[/h1]
In certain conditions, after the “Infinite Trials” mode was unlocked, it could become inaccessible. We’ve now fixed it so that never happens. After you complete zone 30 you should see “Zone ∞/∞” like in the image above. If you don’t see that, please complete zone 30 again to properly unlock infinite mode.

[h1]Small tweaks[/h1]
As always, we’ve been watching the Youtube videos and Twitch streams of BFF or Die and made some tweaks to particular levels to make the difficulty curve even more satisfying.

[h1]Online Multiplayer with Parsec[/h1]
We always encourage people to play BFF or Die in co-op mode as this is what the game was built for. If you didn’t already hear, you can now play as if it were an online multiplayer by using Parsec. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791462498339/announcements/detail/1682551398073335474]Read our previous community post to find out how to do that[/url].

[h1]1%[/h1]
Only about 1% of people leave a Steam review. If you have fun playing BFF or Die and appreciate that we wanted to create a purely co-operative experience then please be one of those people and write that review. The automated overlord that we know as THE ALGORITHM will only smile down upon our couch co-op if you show us some literary love.

Cheers,
Alex, Shaz, Anj
ASA Studio

notes.title: The Second Update: Boosted Challenge!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32976931/19df2ba3ba7debd0f64f23c955418a28a9719fb1.png[/img]

The second update to BFF or Die is now live on Steam. We’ve been listening to people’s feedback and watching all the playthroughs on Youtube and Twitch. (Here’s a fun fact - [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vG7nIiIwAKs]the video that Logitech G made[/url] is now the most viewed video of a single game on their channel with over half a million views so far!)

From what we can tell, people on Steam really do love a challenge. In this update we’ve changed various aspects of the story game in 1, 2, 3 and 4 player modes so that the excitement kicks in sooner and the challenge gets ramped up.

We always encourage people to play BFF or Die in co-op mode as this is what the game was built for. If you didn’t already hear, you can now play as if it were an online multiplayer by using Parsec. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791462498339/announcements/detail/1682551398073335474]Read our previous community post to find out how to do that[/url].

We’ve also started adding our favourite quotes from Steam reviews to the main store page, so if you write something interesting/insightful/funny/heart-warming in your review then we may add a quote!

We’ll be continuing to listen to feedback to help us figure out what updates to make in the future in addition to the things we already have planned. Have fun!

Cheers,
Alex, Shaz, Anj (ASA Studio)

notes.title: The First Update!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32976931/5568574b2533860de0a5ca501c5b89dcbe96d756.png[/img]

The first update for BFF or Die in now live on Steam. These are mostly small details that have been adjusted and you can see the details below. We've been listening to feedback and watching the Twitch streams and Youtube videos that are being made to see which aspects should be adjusted.

[u]Launch Settings[/u]
You can now select the launch settings you want (graphics quality and screen resolution) and they won’t be overridden by the settings from the last time you played.

[u]Options Menu Console[/u]
Pressing “Enter” on keyboard will now confirm selections.
Fix: “Home” button stays visible when it should.

[u]Space Base[/u]
The holo-walls in the Space Base have been extended. A few visitors to the Space Base were a bit scared when it seemed they could occasionally see the black void of space right behind them and no walls! Of course, the secure anti-vacuum tech the Orbees built was working all along so there was never any danger to anyone!

[u]Re-Motivated Mummies[/u]
On a few rare occasions Chase-Mummies were giving up and not bothering to move, even if zapped with the Drone Launcher! They have since re-discovered their work ethic and will endeavour to keep doing what they do.

[u]Zone Settings[/u]
A few adjustments ‘under the hood’.

[u]Reviving[/u]
The Revive-Tech powered by your Time Academy suits got an upgrade! Now you can revive multiple friends in quick succession!

[u]Pause When In Background[/u]
If you minimise the game and open a different window/app BFF or Die will pause and go silent.

[u]We’re Listening[/u]
We’ll continue to listen to feedback and watch the reactions we see to BFF or Die. We’ll also start adding our favorite Steam reviews to the store text..!

Once you complete the story game in 1-player mode, try it  in 2, 3 or 4-player mode as the challenges will change and the overall experience will be quite different. Then try “The Infinite Trials” if you want to really challenge yourself and/or your team.

Cheers,
Alex, Shaz and Anj (ASA Studio)

notes.title: BFF or Die: Progress Update, 9th Sep
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32976931/56f9894e591c4097b2ced3b98c52ae8826599346.jpg[/img]

Hey,
Shaz here, the game designer on BFF or Die. Just writing a quick post to say that, at the moment,  everything is on track for release on Thursday 13th September..! :)

We’ve been sending out test builds to people with different configurations of Windows, Mac and Linux and all is going well, the game is running smoothly and we think all the main issues have been fixed so the game can be enjoyed as intended.

We’re both excited and nervous and hope you’ll appreciate this thing we’ve been crafting for over four years now. Whether you play in single player mode or local co-op with a few friends, you can be assured we have spent *a lot* of time and effort making sure you’ll have a really engaging and enjoyable experience

You never know how things will go when you work on something intensely and then put it out there for other people to experience and judge. We’re def proud of getting this far though. We’re a small team of three who all have different obligations outside of this project and seeing our game in our respective Steam Libraries side by side with other games we’ve had great times with is a good feeling :)

Anyway, I better get back to my final checklist of things to do..!

See ya later,
Shaz
